description: Labelled ground-truth corpus for entity-audit (ENT-01/02/03/04). Clean cases carry an empty expectation on purpose: they are the false-positive control.

cases.label: clean
cases.note: Organization with sameAs, Product with matching aggregateRating text, single self-referencing canonical.

cases.label: clean
cases.note: Organization and WebSite nested inside @graph rather than top-level; sameAs to github.com.

cases.label: clean
cases.note: aggregateRating present in markup but no rating number stated in visible text — nothing to disagree with, so ENT-03 must stay silent rather than guess.

cases.label: defect
cases.note: No JSON-LD at all, but a valid canonical — isolates ENT-01 from ENT-04.

cases.label: defect
cases.note: Trailing comma makes the JSON-LD block invalid.

cases.label: defect
cases.note: Organization with name+url but no sameAs at all.

cases.label: defect
cases.note: Markup says 4.8, visible text says 3.2 out of 5.

cases.label: defect
cases.note: Two different canonical hrefs on one page.

cases.label: defect
cases.note: Canonical points to a different hostname than the page itself.

cases.label: clean
cases.note: Product.brand references an @id an Organization node on the same page actually defines — the reference resolves, so ENT-11 must stay silent.

cases.label: clean
cases.note: A resolved local brand reference, plus a schema.org additionalType (not an entity-valued property, never walked) and an off-domain manufacturer URI (classified external, not dangling) — both correctly ignored.

cases.label: defect
cases.note: Product.brand references @id '#organization-1', which no node on the page defines. Also isolates nothing: this fixture has no identity-type node at all, so ENT-01-no-identity-type legitimately fires alongside it.

cases.label: defect
cases.note: Product.brand is a same-origin absolute URL fragment not defined on this page — a low-severity, medium-confidence cross-page reference, not a hard dangling-fragment defect.

cases.label: defect
cases.note: A grounded, well-formed Organization node (sameAs present, so ENT-02 stays silent) that nothing on the page references, alongside a Product node with no brand/publisher/author link at all.
